target_definition: ticket entry tap-ins per entry_stop_id × service_date × time_period
coverage_note: Smart-card and mobile-QR transactions only; cash riders are not observed.

train.mape_note: MAPE is calculated only where observed tap-ins are above zero; ordinary MAPE is undefined at zero.

validation.mape_note: MAPE is calculated only where observed tap-ins are above zero; ordinary MAPE is undefined at zero.

test.mape_note: MAPE is calculated only where observed tap-ins are above zero; ordinary MAPE is undefined at zero.

leakage_guard: Lag and rolling features use only earlier same stop-period days.
